overview:
Kathu is the district of Phuket that lies between Patong on the west coast and Phuket Town, so it is inland rather than on the beach; Patong Beach is the nearest sea. We list two completed condominium projects here, Dcondo Reef Kathu and The Origin Kathu-Patong, with advertised starting prices from about THB 2.3 million.
For Dcondo Reef the developer's site gives about 2.6 km to the Phuket campus of Prince of Songkla University, about 3.5 km to Central Phuket, about 7 km to Patong Beach, and 5-10 minutes to Bangkok Hospital Phuket; the airport is about 32 km (40 minutes) by car. The Origin Kathu-Patong is placed by its developer between Patong Beach and the Old Town; its own distances are not published yet, so ask us for travel times.
